question: 单项选择：He told me not _____ late again. A. be  B. to be  C. being  D. been
answer: 答案：B. to be。解析：tell sb. not to do"告诉某人不做"。late"迟到"。

question: 单项选择：Please ask her not _____ here. A. smoke  B. to smoke  C. smoking  D. A and B
answer: 答案：B. to smoke。解析：ask sb. not to do"请某人不做"。smoke"吸烟"。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：She wanted me ______ (not, tell) anyone the secret.
answer: 答案：not to tell。解析：want sb. not to do"想要某人不做"。anyone"任何人"。the secret"秘密"。

question: 单项选择：I hope not _____ the mistake again. A. make  B. to make  C. making  D. made
answer: 答案：B. to make。解析：hope not to do"希望不做"。the mistake"错误"。

question: 翻译句子：老师告诉学生不要在走廊里跑。
answer: 答案：The teacher told the students not to run in the hallway. 解析：tell sb. not to do"告诉某人不做"。

question: 单项选择：My mother asked me not _____ too much junk food. A. eat  B. to eat  C. eating  D. ate
answer: 答案：B. to eat。解析：ask sb. not to do"请某人不做"。junk food"垃圾食品"。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：He told me ______ (not, be) late for class.
answer: 答案：not to be。解析：tell sb. not to do"告诉某人不做"。late for class"上课迟到"。

question: 单项选择：Please remind me _____ the lights when I leave. A. turn off  B. to turn off  C. turning off  D. turned off
answer: 答案：B. to turn off。解析：remind sb. to do"提醒某人做"。the lights"灯"。

question: 翻译句子：我不希望他再犯同样的错误。
answer: 答案：I don't want him to make the same mistake again. 解析：don't want sb. to do"不希望某人做"。the same mistake"同样的错误"。

question: 单项选择：She told the children not _____ in the park. A. play  B. to play  C. playing  D. played
answer: 答案：B. to play。解析：tell sb. not to do"告诉某人不做"。in the park"在公园里"。
